report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN technical report
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to validate identified desire lines by comparing them against the 'Go Dutch' scenario outputs and to forecast potential growth for cycling within Kendal.
other_tools_developed: LCWIP Prioritisation framework (Table 5.1) using 20 criteria across Effectiveness, Policy, Economic, and Deliverability categories; Assessment and Sifting Tool (EAST); Route Selection Tool (RST); Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has directly influenced the development of a prioritised programme of infrastructure improvements, informed the design of the Kendal Northern Access Route (KNAR) business case, and provided a strategic framework for leveraging future government funding and developer contributions.
pct_usage_quote: The desire lines were compared against the PCT Go Dutch scenario outputs, which presents a potential scenario of available, as well as a similar attitude toward cycling.
